source.title: [re:DEFINICIJA] Marko Matijašević: Kako primiti financijski blagoslov (ep. 5)

summary.title_hr: [re:DEFINICIJA] Marko Matijašević: Kako primiti financijski blagoslov (ep. 5)
summary.abstract_hr: U petoj epizodi podcasta Redefinicija voditelj Krunoslav razgovara s Markom Matijaševićem, predsjednikom udruge Eho, koja se bavi evangelizacijom i odgojem vjernika kroz brojne programe i konferencije. Marko opisuje sebe prvenstveno kao muža i oca te govori o liderstvu muškarca, strahu od odbacivanja i svom petogodišnjem osvajanju supruge Mirjane. Iskreno opisuje izazove bračnog života dvoje poduzetnika s malom djecom i ističe da je brak u Hrvatskoj u krizi, ali se o tome premalo otvoreno govori. Veći dio razgovora posvećen je financijama u braku, gdje zagovara transparentnost i zajedničko upravljanje novcem, te davanju desetine kao biblijskom putu prema Božjem blagoslovu. Epizoda završava blic pitanjima, izazovom za slušatelje da mjesec dana bilježe obrazac ponašanja koji žele promijeniti te isječkom iz najave sljedeće epizode.
key_topics: osvajanje žene i strah od odbacivanja

speakers.role_en: interlocutor (clip from the preview of the next episode)

key_points: Marko se predstavlja prije svega kao muž i otac, a tek zatim kao teolog i voditelj, upozoravajući na zamku poistovjećivanja vlastite vrijednosti s onim čime se netko bavi.
Udruga Eho nastala je iz pet savjeta koje Tobit daje sinu Tobiji, a cilj joj je pomoći vjernicima da žive svoje uvjerenje u svakodnevnom životu. Eho konferencija održava se svake godine od 2014.
Marko smatra da je temeljni problem muškaraca strah od odbacivanja i izbjegavanje odgovornosti. Ističe da ga najviše motiviraju sinovi, koji upijaju ono što on jest, a ne ono što govori.

Brak je, prema njegovim riječima, u krizi u Hrvatskoj i među vjernicima, ali se o problemima šuti radi očuvanja slike idealne katoličke obitelji. Zato zagovara iskrenost i otvoreno govorenje o vlastitim slabostima.

Najveći problemi s financijama u braku proizlaze iz tajnosti i razdvojenih financija. Ako je žena sposobnija upravljati novcem, treba joj to prepustiti, a u slučaju stalnih dugova nije sramota potražiti stručnu pomoć.
Desetina je, prema Marku, namijenjena evangelizaciji i onima koji služe Bogu, a ne humanitarnim svrhama. Ljubav iz Novog zavjeta ne ukida zakon desetine, nego ide iznad njega.
Za izazov u idućem mjesecu predlaže da slušatelji svaki dan zapisuju kad padnu u obrazac ponašanja koji žele promijeniti, jer se ne može ispraviti ono čega nismo svjesni.
key_topics_en: courting a woman and fear of rejection
key_points_en: Marko introduces himself above all as a husband and father, and only then as a theologian and leader, warning of the trap of identifying one's own worth with what someone does.

The association Eho emerged from five pieces of advice that Tobit gives to his son Tobiah, and its goal is to help believers live their conviction in everyday life. The Eho conference has been held every year since 2014.

Marko considers that the fundamental problem of men is fear of rejection and avoidance of responsibility. He emphasizes that he is most motivated by his sons, who absorb what he is, and not what he says.

Marriage is, according to his words, in crisis in Croatia and among believers, but there is silence about the problems for the sake of preserving the image of the ideal Catholic family. Therefore, he advocates honesty and speaking openly about one's own weaknesses.

The greatest problems with finances in marriage arise from secrecy and separated finances. If the wife is more capable of managing money, it should be left to her, and in the case of constant debts, it is no shame to seek professional help.

Tithing is, according to Marko, intended for evangelization and for those who serve God, and not for humanitarian purposes. The love of the New Testament does not abolish the law of tithing, but goes beyond it.

For the challenge in the coming month, he suggests that listeners write down every day when they fall into a behavioral pattern they want to change, because what we are not aware of cannot be corrected.
summary.title_en: [re:DEFINICIJA] Marko Matijašević: How to Receive Financial Blessing (ep. 5)
summary.abstract_en: In the fifth episode of the Redefinicija podcast, host Krunoslav talks with Marko Matijašević, president of the association Eho, which engages in evangelization and the formation of believers through numerous programs and conferences. Marko describes himself primarily as a husband and father and speaks about male leadership, the fear of rejection, and his five-year courtship of his wife Mirjana. He honestly describes the challenges of married life of two entrepreneurs with small children and emphasizes that marriage in Croatia is in crisis, but this is discussed too little openly. A larger part of the conversation is dedicated to finances in marriage, where he advocates transparency and joint money management, as well as giving tithing as a biblical path toward God's blessing. The episode concludes with rapid-fire questions, a challenge for listeners to record for a month a behavioral pattern they wish to change, and a clip from the preview of the next episode.
